description: S1 prefill SDPA: one q chunk per core (no causal pairing) in the chunked prefill SDPA, 96 busy cores in 16 chains of 6 instead of 48 in 8; flag 0x8 of the per-call chain word (factory edit apply_factory_ps.py, graft K64j-OQ), selected at the model by QWEN_FAST_SDPA_PF_ONEQ=1

levers.name: S1 prefill SDPA one q chunk per core
levers.reason: the chunked prefill SDPA pairs q chunk i with 15-i per core, so 48 of the grid's 130 cores work and the call costs 2K+17 128x128 blocks (K = context/128); one q chunk per core makes it K+16 on 96 cores with the same per-chunk arithmetic and k-chunk order (the only cost that grows with context: est. -7.9 s at a 128k and -29.8 s at a 254k solo prefill). READ NOTE: this lever acts in PREFILL, so the steady-window decode rounds of the ABAB below cannot show it: the audited attach (ONEQA) is its exactness gate, and its effect is read as solo TTFT with the solo prefill ladder (references/fusion-jobs/WPP OQ-T1..T4: prefill_ladder_solo on the production profile and on this twin, ABAB, read with prefill_ladder_report.py: the 131,072 and 253,920 rungs; est. -7.9 s and -29.8 s)

profiles.name: all-oneq
profiles.reason: the combined arm (every fx-all lever on) plus the prefill SDPA with one q chunk per core: the lever measured on top of the fusion programme, the timed arm of the solo TTFT pair OQ-T2/OQ-T4 (the control is fx-all itself); needs the image of OQ-B0 (the K64j-OQ _ttnncpp.so)

profiles.name: all-oneq-audit
profiles.reason: the combined audited arm (every fx-all lever with its audit) plus oneq with its audit: the audited attach OQ-A1, exactness of the whole composition in one boot (oneq's audit compares the chain's program and the one-chunk-per-core program bit for bit on every chip); not a timing arm

Card M passed (WPP/OQ-Q1-sweep: 360 of 360 exact, 0.50x per layer)

notes: DONE IN THIS BRANCH (tp4/prefill-sdpa; the integrator has nothing to wire except the two lines marked WP0 below). (1) tp_addresses.install() imports sdpa_pf_oneq_tp and calls its install(environ) only when QWEN_FAST_SDPA_PF_ONEQ or QWEN_FAST_SDPA_PF_ONEQ_AUDIT is set (any value; a malformed one raises at attach, a missing QWEN_FAST_SDPA_PF=1 raises, '0' binds nothing); the module is an image_files entry (overlay manifest) and test_serving_image_copy_closure lists it as overlay-only. (2) THE BINARY: the whole image is switched with an accept-set, not a flag-gated acceptance (the ABAB control arms run flag-off on the same baked image, so a flag-gated acceptance would refuse the control or split the pair onto two images): job key C2_BAKE_GRAFT=K64j-OQ (c2_serving_job.py, the workflow's Build step, build-c2-serving-image.sh) bakes ~/opgraft-K64j-OQ through the Dockerfile's GRAFT_NAME/GRAFT_SHA build args (defaults K64j, so the default build is byte-identical); G1 holds the image to the graft its context holds; packed_any_admission accepts K64j and K64j-OQ (SERVED_BINARIES, binary 2b81e28f...), K64j-OQ borrows K64j's evidence in a GATE boot only, a traffic boot needs records made on K64j-OQ. (3) WP0, ONE LINE: build the window image with references/fusion-jobs/WPP/OQ-B0-build-oq.env (the fusion B0 plus C2_BAKE_GRAFT=K64j-OQ) instead of B0, or add C2_BAKE_GRAFT=K64j-OQ to the generated B0 in make_fusion_jobs.py, so the generated ONEQ jobs (pack_last) and the WPP jobs find the oneq binary. (4) EVIDENCE AND PINS: optimisation/ttnn-op/sdpa_prefill_oneq/README.md, 'Integration into an image': packed_any_evidence_tp4.json, packed_any_evidence_tp4_262144.json and the pair's packed_any_evidence.json name the K64j binary (voided for TRAFFIC on K64j-OQ; ordered_writer_evidence_tp4.json does not and stays valid); requalification on card M is 48 minutes for the 131,328 record and 100 for the 262,144 one (about 136 in one window), with record_packed_any_evidence_tp4.py --binary k64j-oq. (5) CARD RESULTS (card M, W1 run 38066157833 and Q1 run 38066212228): watcher 10 of 10 exact; 360 of 360 byte-exact against the stock path; per layer served -> oneq 0.96 -> 0.69 ms at 4k, 8.73 -> 4.58 at 34k, 33.17 -> 16.80 at 131k, 64.27 -> 32.34 at 254k (0.50x); oneq_noc 0.68x, not used.
